title: 6-Day Serengeti, Ngorongoro & Masai Mara
description: Cross the border for the ultimate East African safari experience, from the Ngorongoro Crater to the Serengeti and Masai Mara.
longDescription: This cross-border safari is the pinnacle of East African wildlife experiences. Descend into the Ngorongoro Crater, cross the vast Serengeti plains, and finish in Kenya's legendary Masai Mara. Six days of non-stop wildlife encounters across two countries.
included: All park entrance fees both countries

itinerary.title: Arusha to Ngorongoro
itinerary.description: Drive from Arusha to Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Settle at the crater rim lodge with breathtaking views.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.description: Descend into the crater for a full day of wildlife viewing. The crater floor hosts nearly 30,000 animals.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro to Serengeti
itinerary.description: Cross the Serengeti plains, with game viewing en route. Arrive at the central Serengeti for afternoon game drive.

itinerary.title: Full Day Serengeti
itinerary.description: Full day exploring the Serengeti, following the migration if in season. Morning and afternoon game drives.

itinerary.title: Serengeti to Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Cross the border into Kenya and enter the Masai Mara for a sunset game drive.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Final morning game drive, then return to Nairobi arriving late afternoon.

title: 8-Day Kenya & Tanzania Combined Safari
description: The ultimate East Africa safari combining Kenya and Tanzania's finest parks in one unforgettable 8-day journey.
longDescription: This comprehensive 8-day safari is the definitive East African experience. Start at Lake Nakuru, continue to the Masai Mara, cross into Tanzania for the Serengeti, descend into the Ngorongoro Crater, and finish at Lake Manyara. Eight days of extraordinary wildlife encounters spanning two countries and five iconic destinations.
highlights: Serengeti and Masai Mara in one trip

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Lake Nakuru
itinerary.description: Drive to Lake Nakuru. Afternoon game drive to see flamingos, rhinos, and leopards.

itinerary.title: Lake Nakuru to Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Morning game drive at Nakuru, then transfer to the legendary Masai Mara.

itinerary.title: Full Day Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Full day of game drives in the Mara, chasing the Big Five.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Serengeti
itinerary.description: Cross the border into Tanzania and enter the Serengeti.

itinerary.title: Full Day Serengeti
itinerary.description: Full day in the Serengeti following the Great Migration routes.

itinerary.title: Serengeti to Ngorongoro
itinerary.description: Drive to Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Settle at the crater rim.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.description: Full day inside the crater, one of Africa's natural wonders.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro to Arusha
itinerary.description: Drive to Lake Manyara for a brief game drive, then continue to Arusha.

title: 5-Day Nakuru, Naivasha & Masai Mara Safari
destination: Lake Nakuru, Lake Naivasha, Masai Mara
description: Explore the flamingo-lined shores of Lake Nakuru, the scenic Lake Naivasha, and the wildlife-rich Masai Mara in one incredible journey.
longDescription: This 5-day safari combines three of Kenya's most stunning destinations. Start with the famous Lake Nakuru, known for its flamingos and rhino sanctuary. Continue to the scenic Lake Naivasha for a boat ride and optional cycling tour, before heading to the world-renowned Masai Mara for unforgettable game drives.
highlights: Big Five game viewing in Masai Mara

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Lake Nakuru
itinerary.description: Depart Nairobi and drive to Lake Nakuru. Afternoon game drive around the lake, spotting flamingos, rhinos, and other wildlife.

itinerary.title: Lake Nakuru to Lake Naivasha
itinerary.description: Morning game drive in Nakuru. After lunch, transfer to Lake Naivasha for a scenic boat ride spotting hippos and birdlife.

itinerary.title: Lake Naivasha to Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Drive south to the Masai Mara. Check in and enjoy an afternoon game drive as the reserve comes alive at golden hour.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Full day of game drives. Morning and afternoon sessions in different areas of the reserve, maximizing wildlife sightings.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Final morning game drive, then return to Nairobi arriving late afternoon.

title: 3-Day Masai Mara Safari
description: Experience the iconic Masai Mara, home to the Big Five and the Great Wildebeest Migration. A perfect introduction to African safari.
longDescription: The Masai Mara National Reserve is Kenya's most popular game reserve, famous for its exceptional population of wildlife including the Big Five. This 3-day safari offers an immersive experience in one of Africa's greatest wildlife destinations.
included: Return transport from Nairobi in 4x4 Land Cruiser

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Early morning departure from Nairobi. Drive through the Great Rift Valley with a stop at the escarpment viewpoint. Arrive at Masai Mara by lunchtime. Afternoon game drive until sunset.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Full day of game drives in the reserve. Morning drive to spot predators, return for lunch, then afternoon drive exploring different parts of the reserve. Optional Masai village visit.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Early morning game drive for final wildlife spotting. After breakfast, depart for Nairobi arriving in the late afternoon.

title: 4-Day Masai Mara Group Joining Safari
description: Join a group of fellow travelers on this budget-friendly Masai Mara safari. All the wildlife, half the cost.
longDescription: This group joining safari is the most affordable way to experience the legendary Masai Mara. You will share a safari vehicle with other like-minded travelers, keeping costs low while still enjoying world-class game drives and comfortable accommodation.

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Depart Nairobi early morning. Arrive Masai Mara for afternoon game drive.

itinerary.title: Full Day Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Full day of game drives throughout the reserve.

itinerary.title: Full Day Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Morning and afternoon game drives in different areas.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Final morning game drive then return to Nairobi.

title: 7-Day Luxury Masai Mara & Amboseli Experience
description: The ultimate luxury Kenya safari with premium lodges, private game drives, and exclusive experiences in the Mara and Amboseli.
longDescription: Indulge in the finest safari experience Kenya has to offer. Stay at premium lodges and tented camps, enjoy private game drives in custom 4x4 Land Cruisers, and experience exclusive bush dinners, sundowners, and cultural encounters. This is safari at its most refined.
highlights: Exclusive bush dinner under the stars

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Masai Mara
itinerary.description: VIP transfer to Masai Mara. Check into luxury lodge. Afternoon game drive.

itinerary.title: Hot Air Balloon Safari
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn balloon flight over the Mara. Champagne bush breakfast. Afternoon game drive.

itinerary.title: Full Day Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Private game drives. Evening bush dinner under the stars.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara Conservancy
itinerary.description: Game drives in private conservancy. Walking safari with Masai guides.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Amboseli
itinerary.description: Scenic transfer to Amboseli. Afternoon game drive with Kilimanjaro views.

itinerary.title: Full Day Amboseli
itinerary.description: Morning and afternoon game drives. Sundowner drinks with Kilimanjaro backdrop.

itinerary.title: Amboseli to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Final sunrise game drive then VIP transfer to Nairobi.

title: 3-Day Masai Mara National Reserve Road Safari Tour
description: Experience the Masai Mara in 3 days: Big Five, 450+ animal species and the Great Wildebeest Migration (Jul–Sep).
longDescription: Discover the best highlights of Kenya's Masai Mara National Reserve in just 3 days and 2 nights. Spot the park's 450+ animal species — from migrating zebras and wildebeests (Jul–Sep) to the Big Five. Includes comfortable tented accommodation or lodge, meals, park fees and round-trip transfers from Nairobi.

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Depart Nairobi at 7:30 AM via the Great Rift Valley escarpment viewpoint and Narok town. Arrive for lunch then afternoon game drive.

itinerary.title: Full Day Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Full day of game drives. Morning drive to spot predators, packed picnic lunch at the Mara River, then afternoon drive.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Early morning game drive then depart for Nairobi arriving late afternoon.

title: 3-Day Amboseli National Park Safari
description: Witness the majestic Mount Kilimanjaro as a backdrop while observing large elephant herds in their natural habitat at Amboseli.
longDescription: Amboseli National Park is renowned for its large elephant herds and stunning views of Mount Kilimanjaro. This 3-day safari provides intimate encounters with elephants and over 400 bird species, all set against one of the most photographed backdrops in Africa.
included: Return transport from Nairobi in 4x4 Land Cruiser

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Amboseli
itinerary.description: Drive from Nairobi to Amboseli with stunning views of Kilimanjaro. Afternoon game drive.

itinerary.title: Full Day Amboseli
itinerary.description: Full day exploring Amboseli with morning and afternoon game drives. Visit Observation Hill for panoramic views.

itinerary.title: Amboseli to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Sunrise game drive for a final wildlife encounter, then return to Nairobi.

title: 5-Day Amboseli, Tsavo West & Tsavo East Drop-off Mombasa
description: Journey from Amboseli through the red earth of Tsavo to the coast, combining safari with beach possibilities in Mombasa.
longDescription: This 5-day safari takes you from the elephant paradise of Amboseli through the hilly landscapes of Tsavo West, visiting Mzima Springs, and into the vast Tsavo East before dropping you at Mombasa for an optional beach extension. Perfect for those who want safari and beach in one trip.
highlights: Drop-off at Mombasa for beach option

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Amboseli
itinerary.description: Drive to Amboseli with views of Kilimanjaro. Afternoon game drive among elephant herds.

itinerary.title: Amboseli to Tsavo West
itinerary.description: Transfer to Tsavo West. Visit Mzima Springs and enjoy an afternoon game drive in the hilly terrain.

itinerary.title: Full Day Tsavo West
itinerary.description: Full day exploring Tsavo West, including Shetani lava flows and more wildlife viewing.

itinerary.title: Tsavo West to Tsavo East
itinerary.description: Cross into Tsavo East, famous for its red elephants. Afternoon game drive along the Galana River.

itinerary.title: Tsavo East to Mombasa
itinerary.description: Morning game drive, then transfer to Mombasa arriving by late afternoon.
